# ankra_cost_autopilot (Resource)

The organisation's cost autopilot policy: how much Ankra may do about cost unasked, per environment kind. There is one policy per organisation, so declare this resource at most once. Every environment kind not named in `defaults` is held at `hands-off`. Creating it while a policy was already set outside Terraform is refused: import it instead. Destroying the resource resets only what the configuration set: the kinds named in `defaults` return to `hands-off`, and the quiet hours and notification route are cleared only if the configuration set them. After an import, before the first apply, every part counts as set. The counterpart of `ankra cost autopilot set`; it needs `billing.manage` and `clusters.write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cost_autopilot" "policy" {
  defaults = {
    staging     = "scheduled"
    development = "managed"
    preview     = "ephemeral"
  }

  quiet_hours = {
    start    = "22:00"
    end      = "06:00"
    timezone = "Europe/Stockholm"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `defaults` (Map of String) Tier per environment kind. Kinds are `production`, `staging`, `development`, `preview` and `unknown`; tiers are `hands-off`, `scheduled`, `managed` and `ephemeral`. A kind left out is `hands-off`.
- `notification_route_id` (String) Notification route the autopilot's pre-notices go to. Unset means the organisation's default routing.
- `quiet_hours` (Attributes) Daily window when the autopilot starts no change of its own. Unset means none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quiet_hours))

### Read-Only

- `effective_defaults` (Map of String) The tier every environment kind runs at, as the platform resolves it.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of the policy, `cost_autopilot`.

<a id="nestedatt--quiet_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quiet_hours`

Required:

- `end` (String) End, 24-hour `HH:MM`; an end before the start runs past midnight.
- `start` (String) Start, 24-hour `HH:MM`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone, such as `Europe/Stockholm`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organisation has one autopilot policy; any identifier imports it.
terraform import ankra_cost_autopilot.policy cost_autopilot
```
